I made an RSS feed for HuggingFace Daily Papers!! 🤗 Just Subscribe here: https://papers.takara.ai/api/feed It updates every 24 hours, completely written as a serverless go script with a Redis cache (to avoid hitting HF all the time). I'm open sourcing the code, you can check out my repo and deploy it on Vercel extremely easily! https://github.com/404missinglink/HF-Daily-Papers-Feeds thanks to @John6666 @p3nGu1nZz for your early support

May 23, 2024 • Technology

James

I enjoy making RSS feeds for sites whose content I would like to follow. I have made an RSS feed for Hugging Face Daily Papers, a curated list of research papers in machine learning. This feed is available at:

